envelope.description: Enforce the file-reference rule on non-path citations in LLDs

body.title: Enforce the file-reference rule on non-path citations in LLDs
body.summary: Add checkNonPathCitationRefs beside pathFormProblem and call it only from finalizeDesignStory.
acceptanceChecks: The DeepSeek LLD's actual refs are refused
A badly formed path-only ref, a root-level file name with prose and a URL with prose are refused
A text-only label, a well-formed path and a standalone URL pass
A refused citation names its id and writes nothing
checkPathForms is unchanged and other artifact kinds are unaffected

tests.name: citations: the DeepSeek LLD's actual refs are refused
citations: a badly formed path-only ref under analyze-bundle is refused, as under code
citations: a root-level file name alongside prose is refused
citations: a URL alongside prose is refused
citations: a text-only label, a well-formed path and a standalone URL all pass
citations: a refused citation names its id, writes nothing and succeeds when corrected
citations: other artifact kinds are unaffected
stored: checkPathForms behaviour for other artifact kinds is unchanged
